01 / HOW IT WORKS

Many ants. One shorter loop.

Each ant builds a complete depot-to-depot route. Shorter edges attract more ants; pheromone reinforces useful choices while evaporation keeps the search exploring.

01

Explore

Ants choose the next unvisited stop using pheromone strength and inverse travel distance.

02

Reinforce

Each generation evaporates old trails and adds pheromone along the best tours.

03

Refine

A 2-opt pass reverses inefficient route segments before an independent distance check.

02 / BENCHMARK

Measured against a lower bound.

The optimizer is compared with 500 seeded random tours, a nearest-neighbor heuristic, and exhaustive enumeration of all 9! delivery-stop orders.
